d: The Account Manager – Enterprise is responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of Enterprise clients by delivering ZainTECH’s ICT and digital solutions portfolio. The role focuses on building strong customer relationships, identifying growth opportunities, and driving revenue through consultative selling across cloud, cybersecurity, data, and digital solutions.

Working closely with internal sales, technical, and delivery teams, the Account Manager ensures customer satisfaction while expanding account value through upselling, cross-selling, and new business development within assigned accounts.
q: 3-5 years of experience in account management, sales, or business development within ICT or technology sectors
Experience managing Enterprise or enterprise customer accounts
Good understanding of ICT solutions including Cloud (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Cybersecurity, Data and analytics, and Digital transformation solutions
Proven ability to drive account growth through upselling and cross-selling
Experience working with major ICT and cloud platforms such as Oracle, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or similar.
Knowledge of cybersecurity, data management, networking, and digital transformation best practices.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
r: Manage a portfolio of Enterprise accounts, acting as the primary point of contact for customer engagement
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, understanding their business and technology needs
Conduct regular account reviews to assess performance, identify opportunities, and ensure customer satisfaction
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure seamless delivery of services and solutions
Manage contract renewals and ensure continued value realization for customers
Develop a strong understanding of ZainTECH’s portfolio across cloud, cybersecurity, data, and digital solutions
Work with clients to align technology solutions with their business objectives and operational needs
Collaborate with technical and presales teams to position integrated solutions across multiple service areas
Identify and pursue opportunities to expand services within existing accounts
Support pipeline development through upselling and cross-selling initiatives
Contribute to account planning and growth strategies for assigned clients
Prepare and deliver proposals and presentations aligned with customer requirements and business outcomes
Participate in client meetings, events, and engagements to strengthen relationships and generate opportunities
Work closely with product, presales, and delivery teams to ensure successful solution positioning and execution
Engage with both technical and business stakeholders to ensure alignment of solutions with client needs
Manage and resolve customer issues in coordination with internal teams to maintain high levels of satisfaction
Maintain accurate records of account activities and opportunities within CRM systems

d: Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

North is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how enterprises harness the power of AI in real-world applications. As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications. Our esteemed clients include industry leaders like RBC, Dell, and LG CNS.
We are seeking engineers who deeply care about customers and want to work at the cutting edge of Agentic AI.
q: Familiarity with GPU node orchestration & scheduling
You understand the intersection of GPU infrastructure, inference systems, Kubernetes, distributed systems, and performance optimization.
r: Lead end-to-end deployment of North in private cloud and on-premises environments, including planning, configuration, testing, and rollout.
Partner with enterprise IT teams to assess infrastructure, security requirements, and data management practices.
Experiment at a high velocity and with a high level of quality to engage our customers and ultimately deliver solutions that exceed their expectations
Design and implement deployment strategies tailored to client needs, ensuring compliance with data privacy and security standards.
Troubleshoot and resolve deployment-related technical issues, providing timely solutions to minimize downtime.
You May Be a Good Fit If
You have experience with and enjoy working directly with customers
You have experience deploying enterprise software in private/hybrid cloud environments
You have proven experience administering large-scale production Kubernetes clusters and expertise with Helm
Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and tools like Git for version control
You have strong expertise in cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, GCP), networking, and virtualization
You excel in fast-paced environments and can execute while priorities and objectives are a moving target
You are fluent in Arabic and English
